display.purpose: Hero headlines and major section titles. Mixed with display-italic for emphasis words.

display-italic.purpose: Emphasis words within display headlines. Used inside <em> tags alongside bold display text.

headline.purpose: Section subheadings, feature titles, large card headings.

body.purpose: All prose content. Max 65ch line length.

label.purpose: Button text, input labels, UI metadata, tags.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Card lift on hover in the app layer. Never on LP surfaces.

motion.name: ease-out-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions: hover, focus, open/close.

motion.name: ease-out-expressive
motion.purpose: Entrance animations (section reveal, modal open). More expressive deceleration.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Micro-interactions: hover color shifts, focus rings.

motion.name: duration-standard
motion.purpose: State changes: button press, input focus, chip select.

motion.name: duration-entrance
motion.purpose: Section entrance animations via Framer Motion.

components.name: Mixed-Weight Display Headline
components.description: The primary typographic signature of Borogodó. Bold Fraunces anchors; italic Fraunces emphasizes one word. LP hero only.
components.html: Seu trabalho tem mais valor do que parece.
components.css: .ds-display-mixed { font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 6vw, 4.5rem); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: oklch(18% 0.02 260); margin: 0; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-display-mixed em { font-weight: 400; font-style: italic; font-synthesis: none; }

narrative.overview:
Borogodó is a mirror, not a dashboard. Every screen is a moment of discovery — warm, intimate, and honest. The design draws from the quality of late-afternoon light in Brazil: color that shifts as you move through the page, surfaces that feel organic and inviting, type that has a voice of its own.

The system lives at the intersection of emotional warmth and structural clarity — Sofisticação Acolhedora. Sophisticated enough to inspire professional trust; warm enough to feel like a safe space to share career truths. Every design decision either serves revelation (helping the user see something they couldn't see before) or belonging (making them feel this product was built for them, not translated from somewhere else).

The reference is Numera's evolved human-warm direction: bold headline typography that mixes italic and weight variation within the same line, saturated section backgrounds that shift chromatic tone as you scroll, human photography integrated naturally into the layout, and copy that sounds genuinely Brazilian.
keyCharacteristics: Color shifts chromatic temperature across sections as the user scrolls
Headlines mix Fraunces bold and italic within the same line — the primary typographic signature
Surfaces are always warm-tinted; cold gray is forbidden for backgrounds
Motion: Framer Motion for section entrances; CSS-only for all micro-interactions and hover states
Depth: completely flat on the LP (tonal contrast only); subtle warm shadows in the app layer

rules.name: The Proprietary Palette Rule
rules.body: Every color is named and Brazilian. No gray-200 or blue-500. New colors get a Brazilian name and a documented role before they ship.

rules.name: The Coral Rule
rules.body: Coral Faísca is used as punctuation. If coral covers more than 10% of any screen, it has lost its meaning. Its rarity is its power.

rules.name: The Warm Surface Rule
rules.body: No cold-gray surfaces. Every surface is tinted toward the brand palette. White is permitted for card surfaces on a warm base only.

rules.name: The Mixed-Weight Headline Rule
rules.body: Fraunces display headlines mix font-weight 700 with font-weight 400 italic on emphasis words within the same line. Apply only at display and headline sizes — never on body or labels.

rules.name: The Three-Font Ceiling
rules.body: Fraunces, Geist Sans, Geist Mono: the complete set. A fourth family is never introduced.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Lifted Rule
rules.body: A surface earns its shadow by leaving the canvas — on hover, on modal open, on popover trigger. At rest, all surfaces are flat. Shadow is a state response, never decoration.

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are never cold-black. They are tinted with roxo-jambo or tinta. A cold black shadow breaks the warmth of every surface it touches.

dos: Mix Fraunces bold and italic within the same headline — this is the system's primary typographic signature
Shift section background color as the user scrolls; every section earns its own chromatic temperature
Use 8px radius on buttons and inputs, 12px on cards — elegant, never bubbly
Verify contrast on every cinza-mudo text instance; 52% L on creme sits near the 4.5:1 minimum
Reserve coral-faísca for sparks: maximum 10% of any screen's surface area
Write all copy — labels, error messages, empty states — in português brasileiro coloquial
Disable all Framer Motion entrance animations when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is active
Ensure all interactive elements reach 48×48px minimum touch target on mobile
Tint shadows toward roxo-jambo or tinta — warm shadows only
donts: Don't use a dark background with neon text or purple-to-blue gradient overlays — the generic AI SaaS tell, explicitly forbidden
Don't use floating abstract geometric shapes as decoration with no semantic purpose
Don't apply the hero-metric template: big number + small label + gradient accent
Don't put a tiny all-caps tracked eyebrow above every section — AI grammar, not brand voice
Don't use numbered section markers (01 / 02 / 03) decoratively when the content is not an actual ordered sequence
Don't build identical card grids: same icon + heading + text repeated endlessly
Don't use cold-gray surfaces; every surface must be tinted toward the brand palette
Don't use a fourth typeface; distinctions are achieved through weight and style variation within the three-font system
Don't apply the italic-emphasis headline treatment at body or label scale
Don't write copy that sounds translated — 'potencialize suas conquistas' is forbidden; every word should sound like a Brazilian friend wrote it
